Interface GUI

public interface GUI
GUI interface providing factory methods for common Swing components.

Implementations are provided by the host application (e.g., emuStudio) and made available to plugins via ApplicationApi.getGUI().

Static utility methods (loadIcon(String), loadFontResource(String, Class, int), addKeyListenerRecursively(Component, KeyListener), removeKeyListenerRecursively(Component, KeyListener)) are provided directly on this interface and do not depend on any external layout or look-and-feel libraries.

  • Method Details

    • loadIcon

      static ImageIcon loadIcon(String resource)
      Loads an icon from a resource, using the caller's class for resource lookup.

      Uses StackWalker to determine the caller's class so that the correct classloader is used for plugin resources.

      Parameters:
      resource - resource path
      Returns:
      loaded icon, or null if the icon could not be loaded

    • loadIcon

      static ImageIcon loadIcon(String resource, Class<?> callerClass)
      Loads an icon from a resource using the given class for resource lookup.
      Parameters:
      resource - resource path
      callerClass - the class whose classloader should be used for resource lookup
      Returns:
      loaded icon, or null if fthe icon could not be loaded

    • loadFontResource

      static Font loadFontResource(String path, Class<?> resourceClass, int size)
      Loads a true-type font from a resource. The font is derived true-type, plain with given size and kerning enabled.
      Parameters:
      path - Resource path
      resourceClass - class where to look for resources
      size - Default font size
      Returns:
      loaded font, or Font.MONOSPACED if the font could not be loaded

    • runInBackground

      static void runInBackground(Action action, Unchecked.RunnableWhichCanThrow task, Runnable onSuccess, Consumer<Throwable> onError)
      Runs a (potentially long-running, exception-throwing) task off the Event Dispatch Thread using a SwingWorker, with a consistent enable/disable and error-handling policy.

      The given action is disabled before the task starts and re-enabled when it finishes (whether it succeeds or fails). On success onSuccess is invoked on the EDT; on failure onError is invoked on the EDT with the unwrapped cause.

      Parameters:
      action - the action to disable while the task runs (e.g. the invoking AbstractAction)
      task - the work to perform on a background thread
      onSuccess - callback invoked on the EDT after the task completes successfully
      onError - callback invoked on the EDT with the unwrapped cause if the task fails

    • addKeyListenerRecursively

      static void addKeyListenerRecursively(Component component, KeyListener listener)
      Adds a KeyListener to given component recursively. Also installs a ContainerListener so that dynamically added children automatically get the KeyListener.
      Parameters:
      component - GUI component
      listener - KeyListener object

    • removeKeyListenerRecursively

      static void removeKeyListenerRecursively(Component component, KeyListener listener)
      Removes given KeyListener from a component recursively. Also removes the ContainerListener that was installed by addKeyListenerRecursively(Component, KeyListener).
      Parameters:
      component - GUI component
      listener - KeyListener object
